exemple: Tom : « I am tired. » → Tom said he was tired.
regle: Au **discours indirect**, les pronoms changent (I → he) et, après un verbe au passé (said, asked), les temps reculent : am → **was**, like → **liked**, will → **would**. Une question rapportée n’a **pas d’inversion** : He asked where I lived. Une question fermée prend **if**. Un ordre : **told me to** + base verbale.
piege: Pas de do ni d’inversion dans une question indirecte : where I lived, et non where did I live.

essai.consigne: Elle a demandé : « Do you like music? » Au discours indirect, cela donne…
options: She asked do I like music.
She asked if I liked music.
She asked if did I like music.
essai.reponse: She asked if I liked music.
essai.explication: Question fermée : asked if + sujet + verbe.
